detail.longDescription: This is fucking awesome. I fanny about with low powered computers and retro games every year or three and get frustrated but slapping a load of archive.org collections in via a webui and shit just works, and mobile on screen controls decent. Maybe I will play a video game on one of those new fangled smart phones after all. # gaming # selfhosted # retrogaming https:// github.com/arianrhodsandlot/re troassembly
